name: dao-feng-shui
description: MVP browser-based traditional Chinese Feng Shui cyclic calculation engine (JSON-driven). Experimental - not production ready.

scripts.build: npm run build:data && npm run build:standalone
scripts.validate: node tools/validate-data.js && node tools/validate-json.js && node tools/validate-spec.js
scripts.test: npm run validate && node --test tests/unit/*.test.js tests/integration/*.test.js
scripts.all: npm run build && npm run test && npm run test:browser && npm run test:mutation && npm run dist
